text: You sketch a handsome network of sprawling thoroughfares for your citizens to traverse. The adoring population applauds its mayor's keen instincts for city planning.
You even add some lush vegetation to your city with a piece of blue chalk, because you can't seem to find a more suitable color for some reason.
alt: WV sketches trees and roads stretching outward from the city hall of can town.
nextCommand: WV: Lay a chalk foundation for Can Town's civic growth.
